product_questions.question: Fused Folio skin. In a fused Second Edition Folio, should the UI skin follow the local genre zone by zone, as bleed zones do, or stay on one genre of the pair?
product_questions.default_applied: Zone by zone through doc 12's `local_genre`, with the pair's first genre where §2.1 falls back to the Folio genre (§11.10).
options: Zone by zone through local_genre, first genre of the pair as the fallback (applied)
One fixed genre of the pair for the whole Folio (the first)
The host chooses the skin genre at the Second Edition door

product_questions.question: Mod sync. DECISIONS 126 auto-syncs the host's required mods. Should joining a modded lobby still ask before downloading?
product_questions.default_applied: No question; the Mod sync page lists every mod with its progress and a Cancel button (§11.9).
options: No prompt; progress list with Cancel (applied)
One confirmation naming the mods and total size before any download
Confirm only for data-only packs from the host, never for Workshop items

product_questions.question: Kick vote visibility. Should the member under a kick vote see the running vote?
product_questions.default_applied: Yes, the same pinned line as everyone else, without a vote of their own (§11.9).
options: Visible to the target, no vote of their own (applied)
Hidden from the target until the result
Visible to the target with a one-line reply field

product_questions.default_applied: The normal rule, with the four stakes lines on the panel before it can commit (§11.10).

Host-only commit after each member confirms the stakes
